## Quick History
- Nanotrasen and the Syndicate engaged in a conflict now commonly known as the "Corporate War," which utterly destroyed Nanotrasen and crippled the Syndicate.
- In the power vacuum left behind by the corporate collapse, the Confederacy, originally a puppet government, seized some of the corporate tech remnants, allowing them to rapidly grow into a major galactic power, the no longer gatekept progress allowing for a quick expansion across the Orion-Perseus arms of the Milky Way. This event was known as the Great Confederate Expansion, and brought society far across the arms.
- However, the Confederacy was never strong enough to hold together their new galactic nation. In the resulting schism, the Confederacy was split apart into many governments seeking claim to their own vast regions of the galaxy. This was a massive event, splitting the galaxy into tribalist anarchy with the loss of a central power.
- Of these many splinter governments, the most relevant ones to gameplay are the Trans-Solarian Federation and the Phaethon Dynasty, two outer Perseus Arm inhabitants - the former being a large, centralized alliance of planets fearful of another great expansion, and the latter being a relatively weak imperialist society intent on expanding their dominion.
- The Trans-Solarian Federation, scarred by the chaos and violence of the Confederate Expansion, now seeks (like many of the other resulting galactic powers) to unify the expanse and prevent another violent rupture at all costs. They have dedicated a signficant amount of their resources to finding and culling expansionist societies, preventing further technological progress and material acquisitions but keeping order in the Perseus arm. They are also the reason for stifled development in the arm.
- Meanwhile, on the farthest edge of the Perseus arm, a crashed but well-preserved ancient corporate battleship was discovered on an old GCE-era desert moon previously thought to be uninhabitable. This news spread like wildfire in the scientific community and it became a destination hotspot for the would-be entrepreneur to eke out their fortune.
- The denizens of the desert moon called Pizk, previously neglected by their Confederate overlords and thought to be deserted by their oppressors have long ago formed their own society. Not long after their introduction to the wider galaxy, the desert moon's population united together to form the "Phaethon Dynasty" after the Sultan, a bibilical figure in Pizkian culture, killed the planetary government and seized power calling the previous rulers "cruel and unjust".
- Soon after the Dynasty's industrialization, and boosting into galactic relevance, they saw the suffering of colonies unlike their own and vowed to help all those that offer themselves to the Empire, spreading revolutionary ideals to all that would listen, with the Sultan as the figurehead.
- As news of the Dynasty's promise has spread and attracted the famished masses of the arm to the Colossus sector, The Trans-Solarian Federation has set their attention on the Phaethon Dynasty and the Colossus Radius, seeing them as a threat to stability of the galaxy. This has made sequestering the technology and ideology in the sector their utmost priority.
- The TSF, while officially neutral to the Dynasty's activities in the sector, remains skeptical of their potential impact. Meanwhile, artifacts found within the sector by the PDV are sent to the Sultanate, but raise questions about the nature of the Sultan's biblical powers... and whether those in power are really as zealous as they present themselves to be.
